title: Why Use Enums?
instructions: Why use an enum instead of regular strings to represent values like alliance colors?

options.text: Enums make your code run faster than using strings
Enums are type-safe, the compiler catches typos, and when expressions can check that all cases are handled
Strings cannot be used in when expressions
Enums use less memory than strings

explanation: Enums are type-safe. If you misspell a constant name, the compiler catches it right away. When you use a when expression with an enum, the compiler checks that you handle every possible value. With strings, you could easily type "Rde" instead of "Red" and the compiler would not notice.
